Germany's Nagelsmann Defends Tactics Ahead of Paraguay Match

Germany coach Hansi Flick's assistant, Hansi Nagelsmann, has defended his team's tactics after criticism from some quarters. Nagelsmann said that Germany committed 'tactical suicide' in a recent match, but he believes the team is focused on success ahead of their next game against Paraguay. The comments come as Germany prepares for the FIFA World Cup 2026 qualifiers. Nagelsmann's defense of his tactics has sparked debate among football fans and pundits.
